description: This Java class configures a Spring Boot test environment with mocked beans for the Fineract project. It provides bean definitions that replace real implementations with mocks to facilitate testing without requiring a running database or other external dependencies. The configuration excludes certain auto-configurations and sets up mocks for data sources, services, and job components, along with specific test properties.

classes.name: TestConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up mocked beans for testing the Fineract project.

methods.name: tenantDataSourceFactory
methods.description: Provides a mocked TenantDataSourceFactory bean that returns mock HikariDataSource instances.

methods.name: tenantDataSource
methods.description: Provides a primary mocked HikariDataSource bean.

methods.name: databaseTypeResolver
methods.description: Provides a mocked DatabaseTypeResolver configured to simulate PostgreSQL type.

methods.name: tenantDatabaseStateVerifier
methods.description: Constructs a TenantDatabaseStateVerifier with injected mocked dependencies.

methods.name: tenantDatabaseUpgradeService
methods.description: Constructs a TenantDatabaseUpgradeService with injected mocked dependencies, overriding production behavior.

methods.name: jobRegisterServiceImpl
methods.description: Provides a mocked JobRegisterService to prevent real job loading during tests.
